post.summary: Place the order: re-checks prices, authorizes the payment, creates the order
post.description: Safe to retry. The cart, not the key, makes this idempotent: once the cart is placed, any call returns its order with 200 (201 the first time). While an attempt is still running, calls get 409 completion_in_progress; keep retrying with backoff, or poll GET /carts/{id} until checkoutState is placed and orderId is set. Stop retrying on any other error. On payment_requires_action, error.details.clientData says what the shopper must do. Where the channel captures payments immediately, the payment is captured once the order exists; a failed capture does not fail this call.

parameters.description: One key per "place order" action; reuse it when retrying that action
